description: This file defines the Customer model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving customer data as well as managing related information such as logins, authorization tokens, and histories.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing customer records and their related data in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database using provided data, applying customer group validation and approval workflow.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer information based on customer ID and provided data.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a customer identified by email.

methods.name: editNewsletter
methods.description: Updates the newsletter subscription status for a customer.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer and all associated data such as activities, addresses, affiliate info, rewards, transactions, wishlists, and histories.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves customer data by customer ID, decoding custom fields.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Fetches customer details by email, decoding custom fields.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByEmail
methods.description: Returns the total count of customers with a given email address.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all customer history records from the database for a specific customer.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Deletes all IP records associated with a customer.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP records for a specific customer.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Calculates the number of IP records for a customer.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Logs a customer login with IP and optional country information.

methods.name: addLoginAttempt
methods.description: Records a login attempt for a given email, increasing attempt count.

methods.name: deleteLoginAttempts
methods.description: Removes all login attempt records for an email.

methods.name: getLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves login attempt info for an email.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Creates a new authorization record for a customer.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a customer authorization.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Updates the total number of attempts or authorized actions for a customer.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes authorization records for a customer, optionally by authorize ID.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Deletes a specific authorization by token.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Retrieves authorization data associated with a specific token.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets the total attempts or actions for a customer’s authorizations.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Adds a token for customer actions, replacing existing tokens of the same type.

methods.name: deleteTokenByCode
methods.description: Removes a token record identified by code.

methods.name: getTokenByCode
methods.description: Fetches token details by code, invalidating tokens older than 10 minutes.
